recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Changing the Profile terminology or adding redundant explanatory prose would conflict with the later no-change decision and add maintenance drift.
issue_request: FHIR-16956 was Published with Persuasive with Modification resolution. It asked the datatype page to clarify the profiling used on SimpleQuantity, include a link to the profile, and use different terminology if SimpleQuantity was not really a profile.
initial_application: Jira records the application comment "svn 14306". Git history maps that to bfae89f160d2798001c532d9b7287299aa6ea82b, "GF#16956 + GF#16977 + GF#16971 - fix data types links", which adjusted the STU3-era Quantity constraint wording.
additional_context: FHIR-9168 established that SimpleQuantity remains a profiled Quantity special case. FHIR-20322 later resolved a challenge to the "Profile Name" heading as No Change because SimpleQuantity and MoneyQuantity are profiles of Quantity and not sub-types. Later source history restored MoneyQuantity as a Quantity constraint, so the current section correctly describes two Quantity constraints.
reconciliation: No source change was made. An empty audit commit was published because the current build-scope datatype page already provides the requested SimpleQuantity profile links and terminology clarification.
